jobs.title: Strategy consultant with Market research
jobs.description:
Required Qualifications & Skills
- 2 to 4 years of post-MBA experience in strategy consulting, market research, or financial services.
- Demonstrated ability to perform business analysis including market sizing, business model evaluation, and financial statement interpretation.
- Analytical capability to construct and defend quantitative arguments through structured reasoning, case-based thinking, and data interpretation.
- Ability to manage and deliver multiple complex projects concurrently without close supervision.
- Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to present structured arguments to senior stakeholders in written and verbal formats.
- Practical experience in corporate banking, financial services, or a digital domain such as e-commerce or digital services.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications
- Familiarity with the competitive landscape of digital banking and payments, including key players, product offerings, and market evolution.
- Experience designing primary research instruments such as structured surveys or interview guides for business or market insight purposes.
- Exposure to cross-regional or global business environments, particularly in a strategy or advisory capacity.

What We Offer

At Citi, you will work at the forefront of digital financial services strategy, collaborating with regional teams and senior leaders across a global institution. This role offers real autonomy, meaningful work, and the platform to grow into a strategic advisor within one of the world's most consequential financial organizations.
- A hybrid working model structured around 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, supporting a sustainable work-life balance.
- Direct exposure to senior leadership and cross-regional teams, accelerating professional development and broadening your strategic perspective.
- The opportunity to build deep expertise in the digital banking and payments landscape, positioning you as a subject matter authority in a high-growth field.
- A performance-driven environment where your analytical and strategic contributions are visible and valued at the business level.
- Access to learning and development resources that support continuous growth in strategy, analytics, and financial services knowledge.
- The scale and reach of a global financial institution, offering career pathways across functions, geographies, and business lines.

Apply now to bring your strategic and analytical expertise to a role where your insights will shape the direction of Citi's digital business globally.

jobs.title: Commercial Relationship Manager, Vice President
jobs.description:
The Commercial Relationship Manager is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

Responsibilities:
- Manages a material portfolio of clients commensurate with role
- Calls on clients to deepen relationships and proactively owns, responds to, uncovers and anticipates future needs, roadblocks or risks and expectations
- Serves as client’s primary contact point and is responsible for managing internal teams to address any customer service issues
- Introduces multi-faceted solutions to clients in building and strengthening an effective portfolio;
- Works with product specialists and subject matter experts to structure innovative and customized solutions that meet clients’ individual needs
- Works closely with Case Manager on the on-boarding and retention of clients, ensuring the appropriate “Know Your Client” (KYC) and other compliance deliverables are met;
- Identifies cross-sell opportunities to deepen and increase share of wallet;
- Maximizes client experience by proactive sharing markets updates, trend and intelligence;
- Execution of strategic initiatives launched centrally at all levels
- Networks with clients, prospects and third parties to identify avenues for new business opportunities;
- Administrate the credit relationship of the client, coordinating and supervising the entire process, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes
- Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and Citi's policies / guidelines at all times
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:
- 6-10 years of experience
- Sound knowledge of banking and investment products and process as well as a track record of providing sound banking and financial advice and solutions to clients
- Demonstrates sound credit skills by being able to structure more complex deals, which can include capital market transactions
- Demonstrates advanced level of Early Warning Detection skills
- Demonstrates advanced credit skills; able to structure all type of credit deals
- Ability to work effectively in team setting
- Ability to coordinate multi-functional teams to provide an exceptional client experience.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication and influencing skills (e.g. negotiation, consultative skills, leadership)
- Ability to work under pressure while making sound decisions
- Highly focused, able to rapidly identify key priorities, clearly communicate the priorities
- A proactive approach in looking for ways in strengthening business relationship with clients, delivers a simple, secure and seamless client experience
- Passion for creating new business opportunities with existing clients and able to demonstrate innovative approaches to meeting clients’ needs.
- Ability to embrace new technology and understand the role digital plays in the experience we deliver for our clients
- Able to quickly adapt priorities based on the latest data insights

Education:
- Bachelor’s/University degree, Masters degree preferred

jobs.title: Program Management Lead, Vice President
jobs.description:
Risk PMO team is a centralized function, serves as trusted strategic change partner for the Risk Management organization, driving measurable business value across the Risk Organization through expert advisory, rigorous execution, and continuous innovation.

The Program Management Lead is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

In this role, you’re expected to:
- Manage a large multi-faceted project or multiple projects aligned with Risk Management Organization goals and target state vision
- Own project goals leveraging expertise to inspire a sense of shared purpose within the project team.
- Organize new challenges and drive business results.
- Use best practice PMO methodology to create a project plan to fit the stakeholders/customers’ needs and deliver within budget on desired outcomes.
- Drive end results of the project as a representative of the business.
- Work closely with the Risk and Technology stakeholders to define a project scope and objectives for project members.
- Prepare, maintain, and submit clear and concise activity/progress reports and time recording/management reports.
- Assess project risk potentials and discover potential problems before they occur.
- Apply a proactive approach in routinely tracking the project participant progress against project goals.
- Define, teach, and enforce the use of good project management practices such as techniques in resolving complex, interdependent activities into tasks and sub-tasks that are documented, monitored and controlled.
- Identify and where required amend the approach to the context and constraints of each project.
- Constantly improve their own and their teams' skills through lessons-learned reviews at project completion.
- Possess the knowledge, skills and experience to be able to recognize when problems surface or potential problems are looming.
- Articulate problems, bring the right people together to solve problems and know when the problem has been properly addressed and closed.
- Promote partner involvement through effectively communicating project status upward and to the internal clients.
- Apply lessons learned from recent projects to future projects.
- Communicate to all concerned parties project milestones, status updates, as well as any existing or potential customer escalation issues.
- Proactively follow escalation and change control processes.
- Own all management reports on a given engagement.
- Promote good working relationships across a project, cultivating the people skills needed to develop trust and communication among all of a project's stakeholders: its sponsors, those who will make use of the project's results, those who command the resources needed, and the project team members.
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:
- 10-15 years of experience
- Strong Risk Domain knowledge; understanding of Risk Segments and their key processes, controls and metrics.
- Strong Technical Skills preferred – understand systems and Data.
- Innovation/AI and agile capabilities.
- Negotiate skills with external parties.

Education:
•Master's degree, M.B.A Finance, FRM/PRM preferred, PMP is a Plus

jobs.title: Program management Lead
jobs.location: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description:
The INTL Strategic Program Manager will be responsible for supporting delivery, execution and governance of key strategic initiatives incl.  major cross-functional/franchise wide business transformation, growth and regulatory change projects.

Job Background/context:

The INTL Strategic Program’s team supports Citi across 93 Presence countries, as well as key strategic programs with Hub Managed Countries. The role will work in partnership with the Cluster and Country Business Execution heads and business/function  partners in order to coordinate the planning and execution of strategic initiatives  and cross functional regulatory change, business transformation programs.
The role requires an experienced change professional skilled at managing multiple streams of work, stakeholders, functions, dependencies, and risks.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead or support cross functional projects through the full lifecycle and ensure they are completed on time, to budget and adhere to the firm’s standards; be accountable for end-to-end project delivery
- Work with Senior Program managers and/ or Senior Stakeholders to create and maintain the high-level roadmap.  Work with team members on detailed project plans/ timelines and co-ordinate sign-off of deliverables
- Implement and run or provide support for an effective programme management governance model in line with Citi requirements
- Produce or support the production of materials for working group and steering group meetings, as well as discussions with regulators where related to the initiative. Provide the support for regular updates to governance forums.
- Ensure Risks are mitigated/escalated in an appropriate and timely manner to ensure programme execution remains within risk appetite. Work with sponsors and respective project steering committees to remove project implementation impediments
- Interface with 2nd/3rd Line-of-Defence teams to ensure programme execution/deliveries/evidence are aligned to 2nd/3rd LoD expectations
- Accumulate lessons learnt and evolve project management practices accordingly
- Maintenance of Program Management artefacts e.g. plan, roadmap, milestones, RAID log, metrics, escalation points, dependencies where required

Knowledge/Experience

- Program management/change delivery experience 7+ years)
- Banking or financial services experience (5+ years)
- Experience with cross-functional / business delivery
- Experience of running regulatory driven programmes; reviews and interaction with internal compliance/audit functions are highly desired
- Knowledge of Citi’s products and services in International Markets is advantageous
- Bachelor degree (Master Degree desirable); Project Management qualifications desirable

Qualifications & skills
- Ability to manage through influence (e.g. management in the absence of reporting lines) including across international stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to interact and work effectively with large, complex and diverse teams and operate autonomously on specific tasks
- Excellent influencing, facilitation, and partnering skills with key stakeholders and Senior Management
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; a persuasive and passionate communicator
- Strategic and goal-oriented thinker; highly organised and structured with analytical mind set
- Capacity to proactively anticipate, identify, and resolve problems
- Business analysis experience and ability to break complex problems into bitesize chunks
- Strong attention to detail and ability to multi-task
- Ability to handle complexity, ambiguity and a fast changing, often demanding work environment
- Passion, humility, integrity, positive attitude, mission-driven, and self-directed

jobs.title: Enterprise Risk Management, Technology Strategy Director
jobs.description:
Job Purpose / Overview
The Director, ERM Technology Strategy, is responsible for defining and driving the long-term strategy for technology enablement within the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM). This role provides strategic leadership across the ERM technology landscape, establishing a unified vision for the respective ERM Programs (Stress Testing, Limit Management, Digital Assets & AI, Risk Identification etc.) and associated platform capabilities, ERM Data domain, analytics, and reporting capabilities that support the firm's risk management objectives.
This role leads the development of roadmaps and the vision for the target-state business capabilities. This includes a standardized and consistent operating model for ERM program-related activities performed within each Risk segment and how cross‑segment solution designs are developed. The strategy for ERM will focus on driving portfolio rationalization, simplification, business process integration, and modernization efforts across key capabilities, including Scenario Manager, CST, MEP, MyRisk/ERDL, BCBS-239 reporting and related risk management platforms. The role ensures technology investments are aligned with business priorities, regulatory requirements, and enterprise architecture/data standards while delivering measurable value and operational efficiency.
Working closely with senior leaders across Risk, Finance, Compliance, Technology, Data, and Enterprise Architecture, establishing strategic priorities, oversees product investments, and guides the evolution of the ERM portfolio. The role serves as the primary bridge between business strategy and technology design, ensuring that product management and technology delivery teams are positioned to successfully execute the ERM vision.
This role reports directly to the Head of ERM Technology & Data

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision
- Define and maintain the enterprise-wide technology strategy for ERM, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and the firm's broader technology agenda.
- Develop and communicate a clear target-state vision and multi-year roadmap for ERM business capabilities and the underlying platforms, data, analytics, and reporting solutions.
- Establish strategic priorities and investment objectives that drive business value, operational efficiency, scalability, resilience, and innovation.
- Identify emerging technologies, industry trends, and market opportunities that can enhance enterprise risk management capabilities.

Business Architecture & Portfolio Rationalization
- Lead the strategic oversight of the rationalization, simplification and modernization of the ERM technology ecosystem, reducing duplication and improving integration across risk management platforms.
- Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Technology teams to influence target-state architectures, integration standards, and technology principles to ensure alignment with business strategy .
- Drive strategic business decisions related to solution consolidation, data management, cloud adoption, automation, and advanced analytics capabilities.
- Ensure solutions are designed to support scalability, operational resilience, data policy and controls, regulatory compliance, and long-term sustainability.

Product Portfolio Oversight
- Provide strategic oversight of the ERM product portfolio (incl. related to the ERM Programs), ensuring alignment between product roadmaps, business priorities, and technology strategy.
- Guide Product Management leaders in defining product vision, prioritization frameworks, and investment decisions.
- Evaluate and prioritize competing strategic initiatives, balancing risk, value, complexity, cost, and resource considerations.
- Establish governance frameworks that ensure consistent decision-making, accountability, regular review and delivery of strategic outcomes.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership
- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across Risk, Finance, Compliance, Technology, and Data organizations.
- Build strong partnerships with business stakeholders to understand evolving requirements and translate strategic objectives into technology initiatives.
- Lead executive-level discussions and reviews regarding technology strategy, investment priorities, transformation initiatives, and platform modernization efforts.
- Drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, fostering collaboration and consensus on strategic decisions.

Financial & Investment Management
- Working closely with the BoW planning team and oversee strategic technology investment planning for ERM capabilities, ensuring resources are directed toward the highest-value opportunities.
- Jointly with ERM Program Leads, Report Owners or System Sponsors/Owners to develop business cases and investment recommendations that clearly articulate expected benefits, risks, and return on investment.
- Along with BoW planning  team to monitor portfolio performance and value realization to ensure strategic objectives are achieved.

Organizational Leadership
- Lead and develop a high-performing team of product management and strategy professionals (currently indirectly reporting team(s)).
- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Provide coaching and mentorship to senior leaders and team members across the ERM technology organization.
- Champion Agile principles, modern product management practices, and data-driven decision-making.

Expertise & Qualifications
- Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategy within large, complex organizations.
- Strong understanding of enterprise risk management, forecasting methodologies, financial concepts, scenario analysis, and regulatory reporting frameworks.
- Significant experience leading business and technology-enabled transformation initiatives and large-scale platform modernization programs.
- Strong conceptual understanding of enterprise architecture, data management, technology ecosystems, systems integration, and cloud-based solutions from a business perspective.
- Proven ability to align business strategy with technology investments and organizational priorities.
- Extensive experience overseeing product portfolios and guiding product management organizations.
- Strong financial acumen with experience evaluating investment decisions, business cases, and value realization metrics.
- Demonstrated success influencing executive stakeholders and leading through complexity, ambiguity, and organizational change.
- Deep understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, product operating models, and modern technology development practices to effectively partner with technology teams .
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and executive engagement skills.
- Strong strategic thinking and analytical problem-solving capabilities.
- Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
- 12+ years of progressive experience in financial services, risk management, finance, analytics, business and technology strategy, product management, or related disciplines, including leadership responsibility for enterprise-scale initiatives.

Leadership Qualities
- Enterprise-minded leader capable of balancing strategic vision with practical execution.
- Strong influencer who builds alignment across senior executives, business leaders, and technology organizations.
- Forward-thinking and innovative, continuously seeking opportunities to improve capabilities and drive business value.
- Highly collaborative and effective at leading through partnership rather than authority.
- Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, complex, and highly regulated environments.
- Strong people leader who develops talent, empowers teams, and fosters a culture of accountability and excellence.
- Results-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.
- Trusted advisor who builds credibility through expertise, transparency, and sound judgment.

Education
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.

jobs.description:

The Banking Business Execution (BBE) team is responsible for developing and executing the integrated Banking strategy, managing common capabilities, and driving cross-business initiatives to achieve simplification, efficiency, and increased productivity.

Within the BBE team sits the Business Execution Lead (BEL), which is a global senior management position responsible for providing support on strategic initiatives and running essential business execution functions. jobs.title: Solutions Design and Program Management Director
jobs.description:
Citi is looking for a Senior Director, Solutions Design & Program Management to lead the design, planning, and delivery of complex technology solutions across a large enterprise portfolio. In this senior leadership role, you will connect business strategy to operational execution — owning solution direction, driving cross-functional program delivery, and ensuring teams have the clarity, structure, and governance needed to deliver at scale. Reporting directly into C-suite leadership, you will serve as a critical interface between technology, operations, and business stakeholders, shaping how capabilities are identified, funded, and brought to life.

Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end design of technology solutions across a large enterprise portfolio, connecting business objectives to platform direction and ensuring alignment with long-term operational strategy.
- Define and communicate a 3–5 year strategic vision for the portfolio, translating business priorities into structured delivery roadmaps and program plans.
- Serve as the primary interface with senior business stakeholders and executives, owning periodic reporting, investment updates, and strategic trade-off decisions at portfolio level.
- Establish governance frameworks for prioritization and triage, enabling teams to manage competing demands, resolve delivery blockers, and maintain solution quality across programs.
- Oversee funding visibility and resource allocation across teams, ensuring clear accountability for how budgets, vendors, and capabilities are being utilized across the portfolio.
- Identify central capabilities required across the portfolio and drive horizontal alignment, ensuring solutions are consistent, scalable, and connected to broader organizational direction.
- Manage delivery risk across all programs, ensuring compliance with applicable policies and maintaining transparency with stakeholders on control and governance matters.

Required Qualifications & Skills
- 15 or more years of experience spanning solution design, program management, and strategic planning, with a demonstrated record of delivering complex technology initiatives in large-scale enterprise environments.
- Expertise in building and evaluating complex business and operational models, using data and metrics to support investment decisions, funding cases, and delivery trade-offs.
- Proven ability to lead multiple teams through other managers, with experience managing performance, developing talent, and building accountable delivery organizations.
- Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with direct experience influencing decisions and shaping outcomes at the executive level.
- Deep understanding of how to connect solution design with program governance, hands-on project tracking, and operational delivery in fast-moving environments.
- Demonstrated ability to manage portfolio-level funding and vendor relationships, with clear visibility into how resources are deployed and where adjustments are needed.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications
- Master's degree in a relevant discipline, complementing a Bachelor's or University degree as a minimum educational foundation.
- Experience applying design thinking techniques to shape scalable solutions across complex, enterprise-wide customer or operational domains.
- Background in e-commerce, platform delivery, or technology product environments where solution design and business strategy intersect at scale.

What We Offer

At Citi, you will have the opportunity to lead at a scale that few organizations can match — driving solution strategy and program delivery that has direct impact on the business, its operations, and the clients it serves globally.
- Strategic ownership and executive visibility, with direct reporting lines into C-suite leadership and accountability for a significant enterprise portfolio.
- A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing the balance to lead complex programs effectively and sustainably.
- Cross-functional collaboration with global technology, operations, and business teams, offering broad organizational exposure and long-term career mobility.
- Access to Citi's learning and leadership development programs, designed to support continued growth at the most senior levels of the organization.
- Competitive financial wellbeing and compensation package commensurate with the seniority and scope of this role.
- A performance-driven environment where your decisions have direct, measurable impact on delivery outcomes, business performance, and operational excellence.

Apply today to lead complex technology programs at global scale and drive the solutions that power Citi's business forward.

jobs.title: Fraud Operations Manager (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.location: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description:
At Citi, we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day.   And we've been doing it for more than 200 years.   We do this through our unparalleled global network.   We provide a broad range of financial services and products to our clients – whether they be consumers, corporations, governments or institutions – to help them meet their biggest opportunities and face the world's toughest challenges

We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as Fraud Operations Manager (Internal Job Title: Fraud Ops Intermed Analyst - C11). Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decision and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future

The Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end authentication, verification, approval and release of manual payment instructions across multiple currencies. The role combines operational execution with oversight responsibilities to ensure payment requests are legitimate, properly authorized, compliant with regulatory requirements and safeguarding against fraud prior to payment release.
You will be expected to provide operational leadership, drive excellence, strengthen controls, manage risks and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure efficiency and the ability to manage workflows within a high‑risk and fast‑moving fraud environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Perform end-to-end authentication, verification, review and approval of manual payment instructions across multiple currencies.

- Validate supporting documentation, customer instructions and authorization requirements before payment release.

- Identify, investigate and escalate suspicious or potentially fraudulent transactions in accordance with established procedures.

- Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, sanctions screening and fraud controls.

- Review complex or high-value payment requests requiring additional scrutiny and judgement.

- Perform maker/checker where applicable to ensure effective controls and accuracy of work at all times.

- Identify operational risks, control gaps and process improvement opportunities and recommend appropriate enhancements.

- Participate in the implementation of new controls, procedures and regulatory changes impacting payment operations.

- Act as a subject-matter expert, providing guidance and technical support to colleagues and cross functional teams.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Banking, Business, Risk Management, or a related field.

- 3–5 years of experience in fraud analytics, fraud operations, rules management, or financial crime risk within banking or financial services.

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

- Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with regional and technical teams.

- Strong verbal and language competency skills in Japanese and/or Mandarin

Preferred Skills:
- Understanding of regional banking operations, customer authentication flows, and payment ecosystems.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities within a high-pressure, fast-evolving fraud landscape.

- Strong understanding of international payment/fund transfer operations.

- Knowledge of SWIFT and cross border payment processes.

- Payment authentication and fraud prevention experience.

- Investigation and escalation management experience.

jobs.title: CSIS Executive Protection Event Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
The CSIS Executive Protection Event Operations Manager is a senior-level security professional responsible for leading Citi's event security program within the Corporate Security & Investigative Services (CSIS) Executive Protection function. This role serves as the principal authority for assessing, planning, and executing security measures for Citi-hosted, Citi-branded, and Citi-attended events globally, ensuring the safety of senior executives, employees, clients, and Citi's institutional interests across all event contexts.

Operating at the intersection of executive protection, risk intelligence, and event operations, this role applies a structured, risk-based methodology to evaluate each event's threat profile and determine the appropriate protective response — from early-stage notification through post-event review. The Event Operations Manager functions as a trusted advisor to event sponsors, organizing functions, and senior stakeholders, and serves as the primary coordinator between CSIS, internal business partners, and external security entities.

The role is accountable for ensuring that protective measures are proportionate, timely, and consistent with Citi's global security standards, and that CSIS's event security framework continuously evolves in response to the changing threat landscape.

●            Flexibility to work on-call, off hours, weekends, and holidays as event schedules require
●            Domestic and international travel required, including to elevated-risk locations, sometimes on short notice
●            Physical on-site presence required during event planning advances and execution phases

Responsibilities:

- Develop and organize comprehensive security plans for executive-level meetings, travel, residences, and general daily movements
- Assist in the creation of Protective Services policy and processes
- Advance locations and complete site surveys for potential threats, ease of access and departure and understand the location to provide and apply an appropriate protective strategy
- Continually identify, evaluate, and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities, and provide EP team the information they need to make critical decisions
- Ensure reconnaissance of locations on the travel itinerary for designated executives are conducted to identify potential risks and countermeasures to mitigate the risk
- Maintain personal profiles and conduct risk assessments of all personnel providing protective service and determine travel support needs including coordination of flight operations, visiting country entry/exit visas and COVID-19 protocols
- Perform logistical support for the Executive's movements by coordinating with hosts, staff, drivers, and others to ensure a seamless and consistent application of protective security measures
- Participate in professional forums and maintain current with trends, actions, and issues with emphasis on terrorism, criminal threats, workplace violence, political instability, civil conflicts and developments in the executive protection field
- Prepare written after action reports and apply lessons learned
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Qualifications:
- 10+ years relevant experience in a private/public sector security environment
- Professional Security certifications
- Experience working in a corporate or financial services security team
- Former Law Enforcement, Military or Government Agent
- Executed efficiently under tight time constraints
- Proven ability to foster relationships and interface with external agencies to promote functional excellence
- Experience in promoting a culture of a strong security risk and control environment
- Demonstrated a broad understanding of security vulnerabilities and crisis principles
- Articulated an understanding of potential security or safety threats, local threats based on geographic location and their impact
- Demonstrated in-depth understanding of risk management and innovatively develops solutions and makes suggestions to senior management to mitigate risks
- Experience with planning and organization of complex and variable projects
- Experience in an Executive Protection logistics position
- Expertise with Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint, & SharePoint - demonstrated creativity in use of these products to provide operational support and solutions
- Ability to work independently and to adapt to various work-paces while always maintaining a high-level of attentiveness and energy
- Provide support to obtain EP team country entry/exit visas and COVID-19 entry requirements
- Experience working with C Suite Executive Assistant and support staff
- Excellent communications and diplomacy skills

Education:
- Bachelor's degree plus equivalent work experience

Preferred Experience and Skills:
- Experience in adhering current security protocols, operations manuals, and guides
- Demonstrated experience in making sound judgements at a moment’s notice
- Has maintained corporate assets, to include lease vehicles and equipment in a state of perpetual readiness enough to meet or surpass requirements
- Can articulate basic understanding of security vulnerabilities and suggests preventative measures to assist in the mitigation of these potential risks
- Demonstrated ability to follow security and safety instructions and procedures; reporting anything out of the ordinary to management and obey rules and regulations set out in delegations of duty, verbal instructions and company policies
- Open-source intelligence and threat intelligence expertise
- 2nd language skills

Event Risk Assessment & CSIS Notification Management
• Manage the CSIS Event Security Notification process, ensuring event sponsors and organizing functions engage CSIS early in the planning cycle — prior to venue finalization or external commitments
• Evaluate event notifications against established intake criteria
• Conduct formal risk assessments using the event security risk methodology, evaluating threat environment, venue characteristics, attendance profile, visibility, and Citi brand exposure
• Determine the level and nature of CSIS involvement based on pervasive risk and Citi's perceived threat exposure for each event
• Maintain an active registry of pending, in-progress, and completed event security assessments

Event-Centric Executive Protection Planning
• Design and execute event-centric executive protection strategies — time-bound, activity-focused protective plans calibrated to the specific risk characteristics of each event, including visibility, attendance, location, threat environment, and Citi brand association
• Apply event-centric protection across operational modes; develop event-specific security plans
• Ensure all protective measures are proportionate to assessed risk and conclude with the event's risk window

Operational Coordination & Execution
• Serve as the operational lead for event security execution, coordinating logistics across internal CSIS teams, contracted security resources, venue security, and external agencies
• Coordinate with CSIS anchors security and intelligence to obtain current threat intelligence, country/city risk profiles, and situational awareness relevant to each event
• Manage on-site security operations during events, including command presence at high-risk engagements as required
• Coordinate with event organizers, facilities, executive administrative support, and business partners to ensure seamless integration of security measures within the event environment
• Oversee access control operations, credentialing, and perimeter management in alignment with the event security plan

Stakeholder Advisory & Engagement
• Function as the primary CSIS subject matter expert and advisor on event security for internal business partners, event sponsors, senior leadership, and Citi lines of business
• Educate and guide organizing functions on CSIS notification requirements, event security expectations, and their respective responsibilities throughout the planning process
• Maintain strong working relationships with external partners, including venue security managers, contracted security vendors, hospitality security teams, and local law enforcement liaisons
• Represent CSIS in cross-functional planning meetings and security briefings related to major events
• Participate in professional forums and industry networks to maintain current awareness of trends in executive protection, event security, terrorism, threat actor activity, and geopolitical developments

Reporting, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
• Prepare comprehensive after-action reports for all significant events, documenting protective measures deployed, incidents or anomalies encountered, and lessons learned
• Maintain accurate and complete records of event risk assessments, security plans, and operational outcomes
• Analyze event security trends and threat data to identify opportunities to enhance the event security risk methodology and operational playbooks
• Track and report on event security program activity, including volume, risk distribution, and resource utilization, for CSIS leadership review

Executive Protection Global Operations & Logistical Support
• Provide support to the global executive protection program ensuring continuity of executive protective services during periods of absence, surge demand, or operational necessity

jobs.title: Strategic Planning and Business Management (VP/SVP)
jobs.description:
At Citi , we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day.  And we've been doing it for more than 200 years.  We do this through our unparalleled global network.  We provide a broad range of financial services and products to our clients – whether they be consumers, corporations, governments or institutions – to help them meet their biggest opportunities and face the world's toughest challenges.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join the Asia Private Bank Business Management team. This pivotal role is responsible for driving strategic planning and  providing critical support to the Asia leadership agenda. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with strong analytical skills and a proven track record in business management within the financial services industry. As a key member of the team, you will work closely with senior leaders across the region to execute growth initiatives, manage governance forums, and deliver insightful business analytics to support decision-making and drive business success.

- Collaborate with senior business leaders to rigorously monitor sales performance and frontline productivity across the Asia Private Bank.

- Analyze industry trends and perform competitive landscape benchmarking to identify performance gaps and opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior management.
- Establish and manage regular market review processes, ensuring diligent follow-up on commitments and action items with regional and market leadership teams.

Qualifications & Experience

- Communication:  Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex information into clear, concise messages for an executive audience.
- Project Management:  Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
- Market Knowledge:  Good understanding of the Asia private banking landscape, including market dynamics, client segments, and regulatory environments.

jobs.title: Managing Director – Head of Technology and Communications (T&C) Corporate Banking, Asia North & Australia and Asia South
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
The Managing Director – Head of Technology and Communications (T&C) Corporate Banking (Asia North & Australia and Asia South) is a senior leadership role responsible for leading, developing, and managing the T&C Corporate Banking franchise in Asia North & Australia and Asia South. The role holder is accountable for delivering sustainable financial performance, ensuring robust risk and control standards, and driving effective client coverage through a coordinated, product-agnostic approach across Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Markets, and Transaction Services. The individual will translate strategic priorities into actionable business plans, oversee franchise execution, and maintain senior client relationships within a regulated Asia North & Australia and Asia South banking environment.

Responsibilities
1 . Business Strategy & Franchise Management
- Develop and execute a comprehensive multi-year strategy for the Asia North & Australia and Asia South T&C Corporate Banking franchise, aligning with global objectives while incorporating local market dynamics, sector trends, and competitive positioning.
- Define and maintain a clearly articulated target client universe across sub-sectors, ensuring prioritisation of clients where the firm can achieve sustainable competitive advantage.
- Establish and oversee the operating model for Asia North & Australia and Asia South T&C coverage, coverage intensity, and resource allocation.
- Continuously assess market developments, including regulatory changes, capital market conditions, and technology disruption, and adapt strategy to capture growth opportunities and mitigate potential risks.
- Deliver against agreed financial objectives, including revenue growth, return on capital, market share expansion, and balance sheet optimisation, while maintaining alignment with broader franchise priorities.

2. Client Relationship Management
- Maintain overall responsibility for senior-level relationships across the Asia North & Australia and Asia South T&C client portfolio, acting as a primary point of contact for key clients and ensuring consistent engagement at the C-suite and board level.
- Oversee the development and execution of comprehensive client plans, incorporating lending, treasury, capital markets, and risk management solutions tailored to individual client needs and strategic priorities.
- Ensure high-quality delivery of the firm’s full product suite, including cash management, trade finance, FX, debt capital markets, structured finance, and derivatives, in a coordinated and seamless manner.
- Drive proactive engagement with clients on strategic topics such as capital structure optimisation, funding strategies, M&A financing, and liquidity management.
- Monitor client satisfaction and service levels, ensuring alignment with internal standards and continuous improvement in client experience.

3. Portfolio Risk & Capital Management
- Own the credit quality, capital efficiency and structural integrity of the T&C portfolio; Partner with Risk, Capital Management, and Legal to construct transactions that meet or exceed return hurdles while safeguarding the firm’s balance sheet and reputation.
- Anticipate and mitigate sector-specific risks, including regulatory shifts, capital market volatility, cross-border sanction exposure and technology obsolescence, embedding proactive risk frameworks into client strategy and deal structuring.
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

4. Risk Management & Governance
- Maintain overall responsibility for credit quality, portfolio performance, and risk-adjusted returns within the Asia North & Australia and Asia South T&C portfolio, ensuring adherence to internal risk appetite and underwriting standards.
- Partner closely with Risk, Legal, and Compliance functions to assess, structure, and approve transactions in line with regulatory expectations and internal governance standards.
- Identify, assess, and proactively manage sector-specific risks, including regulatory developments, market volatility, technological disruption, and leverage trends.
- Promote a strong risk culture within the team, ensuring transparency, effective escalation of issues, and accountability for risk-related decisions.
- Uphold the highest standards of integrity, ethical conduct, and control discipline, safeguarding the firm’s reputation and ensuring compliance with all applicable laws and policies.

5. People Management & Leadership
- Lead, manage, and develop a team, providing clear direction, performance management, and ongoing coaching.
- Set and monitor individual and team performance objectives aligned with overall business strategy, ensuring accountability for delivery against financial and non-financial targets.
- Drive talent development and succession planning, identifying high-potential individuals and supporting career progression within the organisation.
- Foster an inclusive and collaborative team culture that promotes diversity of thought, strong employee engagement, and adherence to firm values.

Qualifications
Experience
- Extensive experience (typically 15+ years) in Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, or related disciplines, with significant exposure to T&C sector clients across both Asia North & Australia and Asia South.
- Demonstrated track record of managing client relationships, originating business, and delivering financial results within Asia North & Australia and Asia South.
- Proven experience in leading teams and managing complex organisational structures within a regulated financial services environment.

Technical Skills
- Strong understanding of corporate banking products, including lending, capital markets, treasury services, trade finance, and derivatives.
- Solid credit assessment and structuring capability, with an understanding of risk-return considerations and capital allocation.
- Good working knowledge of Asia North & Australia and Asia South regulatory frameworks and governance requirements.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, balance strategic and operational responsibilities, and deliver consistent outcomes.

Leadership Capabilities
- Demonstrated ability to lead and influence within a matrix organisation, balancing client, product, and control function priorities.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across senior internal and external audiences.
- Boardroom presence and C-suite credibility: exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate high-conviction themes, challenge client thinking, and command trust at the highest level.

Education & Qualifications

jobs.title: Strategy Senior Vice President – Citi Commercial
jobs.description:
The Senior Vice President (“SVP”), Commercial Banking Strategy is a senior member of the Strategy team responsible for supporting the CCB CEO and the CCB ExCO and shaping and advancing the business' strategic agenda. The role partners closely with senior leadership, regional and product heads, Finance, Risk and other key stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, evaluate risks, assess strategic priorities and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.

The SVP will independently lead high-impact strategic and analytical work across business growth, client and market opportunities, competitive positioning, investment and resource allocation, strategic risk and operating model effectiveness. The role requires strong strategic thinking and analytical rigor, including the ability to develop in-depth quantitative and qualitative analysis, alongside strong commercial judgement and a deep understanding of Citi’s organizational structure, internal processes, governance and stakeholder landscape.

The successful individual will be comfortable operating across both longer-term strategic priorities and immediate CEO and ExCo needs, navigating effectively across Citi to bring together the right teams, data and perspectives.  They will be expected to synthesize complex information into clear decision-oriented recommendations and help drive priorities from analysis through to execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Lead high-impact strategic projects and provide analysis and recommendations to the CCB CEO and Executive Committee on key business priorities.
- Develop recommendations on growth, market expansion, client and segment strategy, competitive positioning, investment priorities, capital and expense optimization and business performance improvement
- Lead qualitative and quantitative analysis across markets, competitors, clients and business performance, leveraging both internal Citi data and external sources.
- Structure complex and ambiguous business problems, identify key issues and hypotheses and translate analysis into clear decision-oriented recommendations
- Lead project teams and independently execute priority initiatives, applying strong problem-solving, analytical, project management and communication skills
- Partner across CCB and broader Citi teams including regional and product leadership, finance, risk, and other functions to develop integrated perspectives and drive strategic priorities forward
- Leverage a strong understanding of Citi’s organizational structure, internal processes, governance and stakeholder landscape to navigate the organization effectively and mobilize the right teams and resources
- Support the development, articulation and ongoing implementation of CCB’s strategy, including monitoring progress against strategic priorities and identifying emerging risks and opportunities
- Conduct competitive and industry analysis to assess emerging trends, competitor actions and potential implications for CCB
- Prepare high-quality materials, analyses and recommendations for the CCB CEO and CCB ExCo and other senior forums
- Coordinate effectively with key internal stakeholders and, where relevant, external parties to support strategic initiatives and senior manager priorities
- Identify opportunities to improve internal reporting, operating processes and the effectiveness of the Strategy team
- Represent and uphold Citi’s values, standards and culture

QUALIFICATIONS :
- Experience in Strategy, Business Management, Finance or other highly analytical function
- Demonstrated ability to navigate Citi’s organizational structure, governance, processes and stakeholder landscape effectively, including working across multiple businesses, functions and geographies
- Strong understanding of how Citi operates, with the ability to identify the right teams, data sources and decision-making forums to advance strategic priorities
- Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to work with complex data, identify key drivers and translate analysis into clear business implications
- Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, develop hypotheses and produce fact-based, actionable recommendations
- Strong commercial and business acumen including the to assess business performance, growth opportunities, investment priorities and returns
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex topics into concise, senior-management ready materials
- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills with the ability to build credibility and work effectively with senior leaders across CCB and Citi
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive outcomes across teams without direct authority
- High degree of ownership, judgement and discretion, particularly when handling sensitive senior-management topics
- Strong attention to detail

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE
- Significant relevant experience within Citi ideally across Strategy, Business Management, Finance, Product, or other roles involving complex analytical and cross-functional work

Data Analytics & Process Transformation Lead  (Derivative Settlements Operations)

Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution?

By Joining Citi, you will become part of a global organisation whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.

Team/Role Overview

The Derivatives Settlements Operations team is recruiting for a Senior Product Development leader at the SVP level. This is a senior leadership role owning the end-to-end transformation agenda for OTC Settlements and Payments across multiple product lines. The successful candidate will set the strategic direction for data-driven transformation, own the investment portfolio and roadmap, and act as the primary senior interlock between Operations, Technology, and Product leadership. This role carries accountability for the commercial and control outcomes of the broader transformation program, and for building and mentoring a team of Product Development VPs and Analysts.

What you will do
- Own and evolve the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for the OTC Settlements and Payments target operating model, aligning it to broader Markets Operations transformation objectives
- Provide senior oversight of forensic reviews across operational processes, ensuring diagnostic findings translate into enterprise-grade, sustainable solutions
- Direct large-scale, cross-product analysis of settlement and payment datasets, setting the analytical standards and frameworks used across the wider team
- Own the full business case lifecycle for major investment proposals — including sizing, prioritization, and presentation to senior management and governance forums — securing funding and organizational buy-in
- Act as ultimate accountable owner for business requirements delivered to Technology, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and platform strategy
- Set the strategy for KPI visualization, dashboarding, and business intelligence capability, partnering with Technology and Process Engineering leadership to embed it at scale
- Champion and govern the adoption of AI, low-code automation, and generative AI tooling across the wider Derivatives Settlements function, setting standards for responsible and effective use
- Build, lead, and develop a team of Product Development VPs and Analysts, providing mentorship, performance management, and career development
- Own senior stakeholder relationships across Operations, Technology, Product, Audit, Risk, and Regulatory functions, representing the transformation program at senior governance and steering committees
- Drive program-level adherence to delivery standards, proactively escalating and managing risk, issues, and status to senior management and executive leadership
- Set the tone from the top on risk culture: appropriately assessing risk in business decisions, safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, and holding others accountable for maintaining these standards

What we'll need from you
- Extensive, demonstrable leadership experience applying data analytics and process re-engineering to drive large-scale business transformation.
- Deep Operations and/or Technology experience within Global Markets, with exposure to Derivatives, Payments, or Settlements operations
- A strong track record leading (not just participating in) the delivery of complex, multi-year strategic initiatives, including ownership of business cases and investment decisions
- Proven experience building and leading high-performing teams
- Established senior relationships with Technology leadership and external technology vendors, with a track record of influencing platform strategy
- Practical, hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g., CoPilot, Devin, Claude) and a track record of driving adoption at scale
- Strong working knowledge of low-code automation and generative AI tooling, including governance considerations for enterprise deployment
- Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the gravitas to influence senior management and represent the function externally
- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
- Master’s degree preferred

What we can offer you
We work hard to have a positive financial and social impact on the communities we serve. In turn, we put our employees first and provide the best-in-class benefits they need to be well, live well and save well.

By joining Citi Belfast, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:
- Generous holiday allowance starting at 27 days plus bank holidays; increasing with tenure
- A discretional annual performance related bonus
- Private medical insurance packages to suit your personal circumstances
- Employee Assistance Program
- Pension Plan
- Paid Parental Leave
- Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
- Access to an array of learning and development resources

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.

jobs.title: Banking, Corporate Banking, Full Time Analyst, Amsterdam - Netherlands, 2027
jobs.description:
You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility and career growth is not a question of if, but when.
Citi is looking for full-time Analysts to join the Corporate Banking team in Amsterdam. Corporate Bankers are relationship-focused finance professionals responsible for understanding the wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients around the world. As a Corporate Banker, you will drive the client dialogue on capital structure, liability management, liquidity and funding strategies, risk management and investment solutions. Unique to Citi, Corporate Bankers are also responsible for deciding where to invest the firm’s capital and executing on those investments. Corporate Bankers work in partnership with various Citi groups across the firm including Risk Management, Investment Banking, and the Capital Markets Origination.
If none of these terms make sense right now, that’s ok! As a Corporate Banking Analyst, you will join a training program in London, where you will receive an in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi’s culture. So, whatever your degree is in we will give you the training you need to excel.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Analyst Program starts in mid-July and begins with an in-depth training program. You will then be placed with a team in Amsterdam.

Your time here will look something like this...
- Conduct accounting and financial statement analysis
- Complete fundamental risk and credit analysis
- Conduct comprehensive analysis of client's business and its needs in order to shape and execute efficient relationship strategy
- Liaise with product and Citi network partners on a daily basis
- Assist in the presentation and development of new ideas to clients
- Structure and execute cash management, trade finance and corporate finance deals

We want to hear from you if...
- You have an interest in business
- You are fluent in English
- You have strong academics

Who we think will be a great fit...
A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.
We'll also be looking for the following:
- Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments
- Knowledge of the global or domestic business landscape is a plus, but not required
- Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills
- Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry
- Unquestioned commitment to integrity ethical decision-making
- Interest in business

We will recruit on a rolling basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Successful candidates will be offered a competitive salary.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Corporate Banker - Real Estate - Director
jobs.description:
The Director will be a senior member of the EMEA Real Estate Corporate Banking team, responsible for independently managing and developing a portfolio of strategic real estate clients, originating revenue opportunities and leading complex financing transactions.

The role requires a combination of senior client coverage, commercial judgement, credit and structuring capability, disciplined execution and effective coordination across the bank. The individual will operate as a trusted deputy to the franchise head on selected relationships and transactions, while contributing to the continued growth, resilience and institutionalisation of the platform.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Client coverage: Own and deepen relationships with listed and large private real estate clients across EMEA; establish direct credibility with CFOs, treasurers and senior finance decision-makers; lead strategic discussions on capital structure, liquidity, refinancing, hedging and funding diversification
- Origination and revenue: Identify, develop and convert opportunities across bilateral and syndicated loans, revolving credit facilities, term loans, acquisition bridges, bridge-to-bond or equity solutions, liability management, hedging strategies and cash management and other transactional banking solutions
- Transaction leadership: Lead transactions from initial client dialogue through structuring, underwriting, credit approval, syndication, documentation and closing; maintain clear accountability for execution quality, timetables and economics
- Credit and structuring: Assess leverage, cash-flow durability, refinancing risk, asset encumbrance, security, structural subordination, holdco/opco considerations, ratings implications and downside protection; formulate balanced, commercially credible risk recommendations.
- Internal coordination: Mobilise and influence risk, DCM, transaction & trade services, investment banking and other product partners; communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and resolve execution issues without unnecessary escalation
- Portfolio and risk management: Maintain disciplined oversight of client developments, exposure, returns, documentation, covenants and emerging risks; ensure timely escalation and high-quality account planning
- Team leadership: Direct and develop junior bankers, allocate work effectively, maintain high standards of analysis and materials, and contribute to a collaborative, accountable and performance-oriented culture.
- Franchise development: Support sector strategy, client prioritisation, market intelligence and senior management reporting; strengthen continuity and succession depth beneath the franchise head.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS
- 10 years+ of relevant front-office banking experience, with meaningful exposure to EMEA real estate clients and transactions
- Current or recent experience in real estate corporate banking, financing-oriented investment banking, or a hybrid coverage and finance role at a major international, UK or European bank
- Demonstrable personal ownership of senior client relationships and evidence of originating revenue, rather than solely supporting more senior coverage bankers
- Proven end-to-end leadership of complex financing transactions, including internal approval, structuring, syndication and documentation
- Strong knowledge of real estate credit, corporate finance, loan products and capital structure; familiarity with bond markets, ratings and treasury solutions is advantageous
- Excellent written and verbal communication, commercial judgement, attention to detail and ability to operate effectively under pressure.
- Track record of influencing senior internal stakeholders and coaching analysts, associates and vice presidents.
- Degree or equivalent professional qualification; relevant regulatory approvals and conduct standards to be satisfied.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS
- Client ownership: Assume effective responsibility for a meaningful portfolio and deepen senior access
- Revenue generation: Build a credible pipeline and convert opportunities across lending and adjacent products
- Execution: Lead complex financings independently, with high-quality delivery and limited senior escalation
- Platform contribution: Increase senior capacity, develop juniors and improve franchise resilience and continuity

Candidates applying for this role must be aware that it is a Certified Role, subject to the FCA and PRA Certification Regime.

The Certification Regime is one element of the Individual Accountability Regime which came into effect on 7 March 2016.

Under the Certification Regime, Citi UK regulated entities (Citi entities) must ensure that employees working in certain roles categorised as specified significant harm functions (Certified Roles) are assessed as fit and proper to carry out their role.

Under the guidance provided by the FCA and PRA, firms should have regard to the following when assessing fitness and propriety:
- Honesty, integrity and reputation

- Financial soundness

- Competence and capability

In order to comply with the requirements of the Certification Regime, Citi entities must take reasonable care to ensure that an employee does not perform a Certified Role without first being certified as Fit and Proper. For this reason, you will be assessed for this role against the Fit and Proper requirements, as described above.

This assessment will be carried out through extensive interviews, self-disclosures, permitted criminal record checks, regulated reference checks, credit checks and other background screening check

Implement best-in-class operational controls and practices to mitigate risks, ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations.

This is an opportunity to build deep sector expertise in one of the most dynamic industries in global finance, with direct client engagement at CFO and Treasury level across the EMEA region.

Responsibilities
- Advise Energy, Power and Commodity Trading clients on capital structure, financing strategy, and corporate finance solutions, acting as a trusted partner at the CFO and Treasury level.
- Lead the origination and execution of episodic and strategic financing transactions as an active member of deal teams across the EMEA region.
- Develop targeted client pitch materials and financial analyses by evaluating public filings, research reports, business plans, and financial forecasts to support transaction execution and business development.
- Conduct credit analysis and risk assessment of existing and prospective relationships, including periodic review of financial performance, liquidity position, peer benchmarking, and financial projections.
- Collaborate closely with product partners across Capital Markets, Commodities, Derivatives, Trade Finance, and Lending to identify cross-sell opportunities and deepen product penetration across the portfolio.
- Monitor market and industry trends in the Energy, Power and Commodity Trading sector to deliver market-leading content and position Citi as a specialist adviser to clients.
- Mentor and support junior team members, building their technical capability and client management skills to strengthen overall team performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills
- Demonstrated experience in a corporate banking, financing, debt advisory, or capital markets and investment banking environment.
- Sector experience in Energy, Power and Commodity Trading, with the ability to engage credibly with clients as an industry specialist.
- Credit analysis capability with a track record of executing episodic financing transactions and assessing counterparty risk.
- Corporate finance acumen, including a sound understanding of capital structure drivers and the ability to develop and evaluate financial models, projections, and sensitivity analyses.
- Quantitative, accounting, and financial modelling skills applied to the evaluation of complex transactions and client situations.
- Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial analysis into compelling client materials.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant field.

- Familiarity with legal documentation including Loan Agreements and ISDA Master Agreements.
- Postgraduate qualification such as an MBA or Master's degree in Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
- Established internal and external networks across product, risk, and regional banking teams within a global financial institution.

Joining Citi's Power, Energy and Commodity Traders team means becoming part of a high-performing group with a strong sector focus and a global client reach. You will gain exposure to market-leading transactions, work alongside experienced Senior Bankers, and build the expertise and relationships that define a long-term career in corporate and investment banking.
- Direct access to a senior client portfolio with meaningful engagement at CFO and Treasury level from day one, accelerating your development as a trusted sector specialist.
- Broad cross-product exposure across Capital Markets, Derivatives, Trade Finance, and Corporate Finance, giving you a comprehensive view of how Citi's platform serves global clients.
- A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing flexibility alongside strong team collaboration.
- Ongoing learning and professional development through active deal participation, mentorship from Senior Bankers, and access to Citi's global banking network.
- The opportunity to develop deep sector expertise in the Energy, Power and Commodity Trading industry, positioning you as a specialist within one of the most active areas of global corporate finance.
- A performance-driven environment with clear career progression, where your contribution to client outcomes and transaction execution directly shapes your professional trajectory.
- Competitive financial wellbeing and benefits package, complemented by Citi's commitment to work-life balance and employee wellbeing.

Apply now to bring your corporate banking and sector expertise to Citi's Energy, Power and Commodity Trading team — and help shape the financial strategies of some of the world's most significant clients.
