jobs.title: Banking, Corporate Banking, Full Time Analyst, Paris - France, 2027 - January Start
jobs.description:
You're the brains behind our work.

You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it's honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can't come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.

Citi is looking for a full-time Analyst to join the Corporate Banking team in Paris. Corporate Bankers are responsible for:
- Delivering Citi’s comprehensive offer of Banking products across its unparalleled 90+ countries and jurisdictions. Citi is a truly global institution, and one the Corporate Bank’s roles is to deliver to its clients’ central finance teams a centralized coordination of global relationships.

- Deciding where to invest the firm's capital and executing on those investments. Most Banking products require capital, and the Corporate Bank is in charge of credit allocation which entails both taking a Risk approach (credit analysis, first line of defence) and a Business approach (return on capital, cross-sell opportunity).

- Working in partnership with a wide range of teams and Products. Investment Banking, Capital Markets Origination, Markets, Treasury and Trade Solutions, Risk... The Corporate Bank works with all of Citi’s Institutional Clients Group across geographies and acts as a Coordinator to ensure flawless client delivery.

To sum it up, Corporate Bankers are relationship-focused finance professionals responsible for understanding the wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients around the world. As a Corporate Banker, you will drive the client dialogue on capital structure, liability management, liquidity and funding strategies, risk management and investment solutions.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

A Best-in-class team

We put our clients at the very centre of everything we do and have expanded and long-lasting relationships with a number of French multinationals spanning all over the world. Our goal is to be able to support our clients on both transforming deals and daily treasury operations almost everywhere in the world.

Citi is a leading international bank towards a number French clients, and one of the best Banking franchises in Europe. By joining us, you would be joining a global leader in its field.
You would also be joining a genuinely international working environment, with interactions with people from all geographies and backgrounds. Diversity is part of Citi’s DNA, and we are proud of it, as it is a great strength in today’s globalized world.

Finally, as a Corporate Banking Analyst, you will join a training program where you will receive an in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi's culture. So, whatever your degree is in we will give you the training you need to excel. On top of that, once you hit the desk, Citi France cares and pays significant attention to career development of individuals to foster diversity at all levels of our organization.

Your time here will look something like this...
- Conduct accounting and financial statement analysis, cash flow modelling and capital markets analysis.

- Complete fundamental risk and credit analysis.

- Liaise with product partners.

- Coordinate with the Bank’s 90+ countries and jurisdictions.

- Assist in the presentation and development of new ideas to clients.

- Structure deals.

We want to hear from you if...
- You are in your final year of university or graduated.

- Expected to achieve 13 (or equivalent) at undergraduate level in any degree discipline.

- You are fluent in French and English.

Who we think will be a great fit...

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.

We'll also be looking for the following:
- Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments.

- Knowledge of the global or domestic business landscape is a plus, but not required.

- Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills.

- Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry.

- Unquestioned commitment to integrity ethical decision-making.

- Interest in business.

We will recruit on a rolling basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Successful candidates will be offered a competitive salary.

jobs.title: Associate, Global Network Banking - Corporate Banking
jobs.description:
Job Description

Citi’s Banking franchise is organized around three lines of business: Investment Banking, Corporate Banking and Commercial Banking. The unified Banking and International organization oversees the local delivery of the full firm to clients in each of the 95 markets where Citi has an on-the-ground presence.

Citi Corporate Bank serves as the conduit of Citi’s full product suite to clients through holistically managed relationships across our unparalleled network.

The Global Network Banking (GNB) Associate orchestrates the delivery and execution of the entire spectrum of Citi's products and services within Australia. She/he will relationship manage an existing portfolio of multi-national clients, analyze existing business news to identify trends in product usage and return hurdles, help identify future business and cross sell opportunities.

GNB within Citi's Corporate Bank strives to be the market's leading provider of financial services to local affiliates of the world's largest and most prominent multi-national corporations. Citi's unique global relationship network is widely regarded by our institution customers as being best-in-class in terms of client coverage and delivery of banking solutions in over 100 countries.

Working for Citi's GNB franchise is an opportunity to be in a Corporate Banker role within a highly-visible organization, and the successful candidate will gain exposure to an open and multicultural working environment. Citi's focus on global mobility will also provide opportunities to work throughout the GNB network that spans the globe.

Responsibilities:
- Manage a portfolio of multinational client subsidiaries to originate and cross sell all Citi's products (including but not limited to cash management, trade, foreign exchange, capital markets, loans) with a view of expanding our local client wallet share in line with the global relationship client strategy.

- Generate revenue growth across all product groups in line with assigned goals by cross selling new products to existing clients, increasing revenue from existing products and new client acquisition

- Within the Banking client base, assist in the identification, qualification. and wallet sizing of prospective clients for new business initiatives.

- Manage credit due diligence, credit excess, KYC and AML requirements against your designated client portfolio.

Qualifications:
- At least 5 years' direct experience in a coverage or client sales within banking services industry

- Demonstrated track record in growing revenues on a consistent basis

- Understanding of banking products (loans, FX, derivatives, cash management, trade) and knowledge of Capital Markets and Corporate and Structured Finance products

- Ability to work within a matrix organization and collaborate effectively with product partners and banking colleagues, locally, regionally and globally.

- Good understanding of financial statements including profit and loss statement and balance sheet

- Proven and progressive related lending/credit experience or equivalent product experience

- Demonstrated credit skills, including a background in credit

- Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products preferred

- Knowledge of Corporate Banking business including related products, pertinent regulations and the lending and credit approval process

Education:
- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Corporate Banking Senior Associate is responsible for assisting in relationship management, credit underwriting, and transaction execution for Citi’s Real Estate Corporate Banking (RECB) clients.

This role sits strategically between the Analyst and Associate levels. It is designed for an experienced professional who has mastered foundational financial modeling and credit analysis, and is ready to take on greater transaction leadership, direct client interaction, and mentorship of junior Analysts.

The Real Estate Corporate Banking group manages relationships with leading public Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), and large sponsors. The Senior Analyst will work closely with Associates, Vice Presidents, Directors, and Managing Directors to deliver comprehensive financial solutions, including syndicated loans, debt and equity capital markets products, derivatives, and treasury services.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Credit Underwriting & Portfolio Management
- Credit Memorandums:  Lead the drafting and structuring of comprehensive credit memorandums, annual reviews, and quarterly monitoring reports for risk approval.
- Financial Analysis:  Conduct thorough credit analysis, including detailed financial statement analysis, corporate structure reviews, and risk rating assessments.
- Portfolio Monitoring:  Monitor an assigned portfolio of real estate corporate clients, ensuring strict compliance with financial covenants, tracking industry trends, and managing credit administration requirements.

2. Financial Modeling & Valuation
- Advanced Modeling:  Develop, maintain, and stress-test complex cash flow models and valuation frameworks for diverse real estate asset classes (multifamily, industrial, office, retail, and lodging).
- Metrics Mastery:  Analyze real estate-specific metrics, including Net Operating Income (NOI), Capitalization Rates, Loan-to-Value (LTV), Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), and Funds From Operations (FFO/AFFO).

3. Transaction Execution
- Deal Execution:  Actively participate in the structuring, underwriting, and execution of syndicated and bilateral credit facilities, bridge loans, and construction loans.
- Due Diligence & Documentation:  Coordinate due diligence processes, review legal documentation (credit agreements, term sheets, intercreditor agreements), and interface directly with Risk, Legal, and Loan Syndications teams.

4. Client Relationship & Business Development
- Pitch Materials:  Assist in the preparation of high-quality pitch books, client presentations, and relationship reviews.
- Client Interface:  Participate in client calls and meetings, addressing operational inquiries and supporting senior bankers in business development efforts.

5. Leadership & Mentorship
- Junior Guidance:  Provide guidance, training, and quality-control support to junior Analysts within the team, helping to foster a collaborative and high-performing environment.

Qualifications
- Experience:  4-7 years of relevant experience in Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Real Estate Finance, or Credit Risk Analysis
- Technical Skills:  Advanced proficiency in Excel financial modeling and PowerPoint. Strong understanding of corporate finance, accounting, and real estate valuation principles.
- Analytical Capabilities:  Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Communication:  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial concepts clearly to senior management, risk partners, and clients.
- Work Ethic:  Highly motivated, self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines. Strong team player.
- Licensing:  Series 79 and 63 licenses are a plus

Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Business Administration, or a related field with a strong academic record.

#LI-RA
Other Skills

- Commitment to personal growth and career development
- A strong desire to learn and succeed in team environment
- Knowledge of the global or domestic business landscape is a plus, but not required
- Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills
- Passion for client service and a dedication to deliver the best results on every project
- Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry
- Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making.

jobs.title: Vice President, Banker, Public Sector, Corporate Banking
jobs.description:
The Vice President Banker in Public Sector Banking Japan is responsible for managing and developing relationships with key public sector clients, including Japanese government ministries and agencies, policy institutions, public pension funds, development organizations, government-affiliated entities, and other strategically important public sector stakeholders.
Working closely with senior bankers and product partners across Banking, Markets, and Services, the Vice President will originate business opportunities, deepen client relationships, and deliver strategic financial solutions aligned with clients' evolving funding, investment, and policy priorities.
The role requires strong judgement, relationship management, and execution capabilities, together with a deep understanding of Japan's public sector landscape, evolving geopolitical and economic dynamics, and the ability to connect client needs with Citi's global network and product capabilities.
The overall objective is to drive sustainable revenue growth, deliver exceptional client outcomes, efficiently deploy the firm's capital, and maintain the highest standards of risk management and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management & Strategic Coverage
- Support senior bankers in developing and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders across Japanese government ministries, agencies, policy institutions, public pension funds, development organizations, and other public sector entities.

- Act as a trusted advisor by understanding clients' strategic priorities, policy objectives, funding requirements, and investment challenges, and by bringing relevant market insights and solutions to support their long-term objectives.

- Strengthen Citi's position as a leading financial partner through consistent, coordinated, and high-quality client coverage.

- Support senior-level engagement initiatives and leverage Citi's global network to deepen institutional relationships.

- Develop and execute account plans to enhance client engagement, strengthen wallet share, and identify new business opportunities.

Business Development & Origination
- Identify and pursue opportunities across Citi's Banking, Markets, and Services platform by anticipating client needs and evolving policy priorities.

- Drive cross-sell initiatives and originate opportunities in lending, payments, liquidity management, foreign exchange, capital markets, securities services, and risk management solutions.

- Partner closely with product specialists and global coverage teams to deliver integrated client solutions.

- Support cross-border strategic investment initiatives and public-private investment opportunities by connecting Japanese public sector clients with Citi's global network, capital markets capabilities, and international investor base.

- Contribute to the development of strategic account plans, client presentations, and business development initiatives.

Strategic Insights & Market Connectivity
- Maintain a strong understanding of Japan's public sector landscape, fiscal and economic policy priorities, geopolitical developments, industrial policy initiatives, energy transition trends, and global capital market developments.

- Monitor market, regulatory, and policy developments to identify emerging opportunities and risks.

- Help connect Japanese public sector institutions with global capital, investors, and strategic opportunities through Citi's international platform.

Credit & Risk Management
- Lead credit reviews, transaction approvals, portfolio monitoring, and risk assessments for assigned relationships.

- Ensure balanced risk judgement and adherence to Citi's credit standards, compliance requirements, and regulatory obligations.

- Partner closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Control functions to maintain strong governance and sound business practices.

Execution & Collaboration
- Coordinate complex transactions and client initiatives across multiple product and geographic teams.

- Drive efficient execution, establish clear accountability among stakeholders, and deliver seamless client outcomes.

- Foster strong collaboration across Citi's global network to ensure a consistent One Citi approach.

- Work closely with regional and global Public Sector Banking teams to share best practices and bring relevant global insights to clients.

Leadership & Talent Development
- Mentor and develop junior bankers, analysts, and associates.

- Contribute to building a high-performing team culture that values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

- Drive operational efficiency through effective use of technology, process improvements, and productivity-enhancing tools.

Compliance & Control
- Ensure full compliance with all Citi policies and applicable regulatory requirements, including AML, KYC, sanctions, conduct, and reputational risk standards.

- Demonstrate strong risk awareness and sound judgment in all business activities.

- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, safeguarding Citi, its clients, and its reputation.

Qualifications:
- 6-10 years of relevant experience in Corporate Banking, Public Sector Banking, Sovereign Coverage, Financial Institutions, Investment Banking, Government Advisory, or related financial services roles.

- Strong understanding of banking products including lending, cash management, payments, foreign exchange, capital markets, and risk management solutions.

- Experience covering government ministries, agencies, policy institutions, sovereign or quasi-sovereign entities, development organizations, or other public sector clients is strongly preferred.

- Strong credit, financial analysis, transaction execution, and stakeholder management skills.

- Demonstrated ability to coordinate across product partners and manage complex client relationships.

- Strong interest in public policy, economic development, geopolitics, industrial policy, and public finance.

- Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

- Native-level Japanese language proficiency (reading, writing, and verbal communication) is required.

- Business-level English proficiency is required, including the ability to communicate effectively with regional and global stakeholders.

- Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA) Class 1 and 2 certifications.

Education:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required.

- Master's degree, MBA, or advanced degree in Finance, Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, or related disciplines preferred.

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Associate - Metals & Mining (UK Industrials)
jobs.description:
The Corporate Banking Associate in Metals & Mining (UK Industrials) is an intermediate level professional responsible for providing bespoke capital structure expertise and corporate finance advice to clients. The Associate is expected to work with Senior Bankers in business origination and execution across Citi’s product set, with particular focus on episodic and strategic financing transactions. The overall objective of this role is to drive revenue by cross selling the Citi platform while efficiently deploying the firm's capital and evaluating and managing risk.

The role encompasses:
- Relationship management of the M&M portfolio comprised of the largest Metal producers and Miners in the world.
- This is an opportunity to join the team with heavy focus on global client set and delivery of market leading industry content, championing the deliverance of Corporate Finance initiatives.
- The Associate will be becoming an expert in the M&M space with exposure multiple relationship teams throughout Citi. They will also work very closely with our Investment Bank and product partners including Capital Markets (DCM, ECM, Acquisition & Project Finance, Leveraged Finance, etc.), Markets (Commodities, Derivatives, FX, etc.), Treasury & Trade Solutions (Trade Finance, Cash Management, etc.) and Corporate Finance / Lending initiatives.
- Providing analytical support, risk assessment and monitoring of existing and new relationships in the Industrials portfolio
- Developing good relationships with the clients and be viewed by clients as a specialist in the sector. The role involves a significant amount of direct client engagement at the CFO / Treasury level

Responsibilities:
- Partner with Senior Bankers to provide overall relationship management support for Global M&M clients along with industry support/expertise for the wider sector
- Member of deal team for the origination and execution of episodic and Corporate Finance transactions
- Responsible for staying abreast of market and industry trends, “best practices” and competitive landscape
- Risk assessment and credit analysis of existing relationships including periodic review of financial results and statements to monitor operating performance, liquidity position and financial condition, peer analysis, identifying industry trends and outlook and preparation of financial projections and sensitivity analysis
- Day-to-day responsibilities include developing client pitch materials tailored to meet client needs, lead execution of episodic transactions / financings and foster and leverage on-going relationships across the EMEA region
- Assist with day to day cash management activities, trading initiatives, foreign exchange, loan activity, debt and equity capital markets
- Responsible for evaluating public filings, research reports, operations, business plans, and financial forecasts to produce strategic and financial analyses

The associate will develop (i) in-depth understanding of the dynamics of the business, (ii) an understanding of clients’ priorities with the aim of identifying appropriate marketing opportunities and (iii) strong relationships internally with key product, risk and regional partners.

Qualifications & Skills:
- Strong experience working in a corporate bank, financing or a capital markets / investment banking role
- Prior experience in the Metals & Mining industry
- Corporate Finance mind-set with strong understanding of drivers of capital structure
- Strong credit skills, credit background and experience executing episodic transactions
- Quantitative, Accounting and Financial Modelling skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, notably Excel and PowerPoint
- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
- Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience, MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred

Competencies:
- Accounting & Corporate Finance
- Counterparty credit analysis and risk assessment
- Understanding legal documentation such as Loan Agreements and ISDAs
- Leadership in team-oriented environment
- Excellent interpersonal skills - able to create and sustain good personal contacts within the client group, balancing client requirements and Citi’s priorities
- Self-starter - prepared to take the initiative to follow issues through, whilst exercising judgment as to when to seek assistance
- Networking - maintaining close contact with product and risk specialists within Citi

Candidates applying for this role must be aware that it is a Certified Role, subject to the Certification Regime. The Certification Regime is one element of the Individual Accountability Regime which has come into effect on 7 March 2016. Under the Certification Regime, certain Citi entities must ensure that employees working in certain roles categorised as specified significant harm functions (Certified Roles) are assessed as fit and proper to carry out their role.
Under the guidance provided by the FCA and PRA, firms should have regard to the following when assessing fitness and propriety:
Honesty, integrity and reputation
Financial soundness
Competence and capability
In order to comply with the requirements of the Certification Regime, certain Citi entities must take reasonable care to ensure that an employee does not perform a Certified Role without first being certified as Fit and Proper. For this reason, you will be assessed for this role against the Fit and Proper requirements, as described above. This assessment will be carried out through extensive interviews, self-disclosures, permitted criminal record checks, reference checks, credit checks and other background checks. If hired for this role, you will also be required to complete an annual declaration regarding your Fitness and Propriety.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the information above and that you are applying for a Certified Role. You also agree to Citi carrying out any additional screening required, including permitted criminal record checks, reference checks, credit checks and any other background checks.

jobs.title: Banking - Corporate Banking, Summer Analyst, China – APAC, 2027
jobs.description:
We want to hear from you if…
You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 - June 2028)

Who we think will be a great fit...
A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking, and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you. We'll also be looking for the following:
* Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments
* Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills
* Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry
* Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program runs for 10 weeks and begins with initial classroom based training, followed by ongoing training sessions throughout the length of the program, as well as a series of networking and social events. Analysts will complete two rotations across different teams within the Corporate Banking group. Incoming Summer Analysts have the opportunity to be considered for a position on the following year’s full-time Analyst Program.

Your time here will look something like this...
* Provide advice: this involves working with our clients to develop and execute their strategic objectives. We advise them on a number of areas including whether to buy or sell companies or assets, how to restructure finances, and where and how to invest capital
* Work with Capital Markets: we work very closely with the Citi CMO team (Capital Markets Origination) to help our clients raise capital in the equity and debt capital markets

You're the brains behind our work.
You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when. Citi is looking for Summer Interns to join the Corporate Banking team in Asia Pacific. Citi’s Corporate Bank is a leading provider of financial services to top-tier multi-national clients around the globe, serving the financial needs of the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions. The Corporate group advises corporate clients who want to raise funds in capital markets and who need strategic support in financial transactions. Initiatives you may be working on with clients include mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, financial restructurings, underwriting, and distributing equity, debt, and derivative securities. As a Summer Analyst, you will join an intensive ten-week program where you will receive in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi’s culture.

We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in APAC region.

jobs.title: Corporate Banking - Summer Internship Program, Tokyo - Japan, 2027
jobs.description:
※申し込みの際添付いただくエントリーシートに関する注意点があります。下記応募方法の欄を必ずご一読ください。

我々、Citigroup Japanは、コーポレート・バンキング部門2027 Summer Internshipの募集をオープンいたしました。

募集部門
Corporate Banking (コーポレート・バンキング部門)
応募対象者：2028年9月までに国内外の大学・大学院を卒業見込みの方

応募締め切り一覧
第一次：9月15日
第二次：10月15日

※締め切り後、5営業日以内にWebテストのご案内をお送りいたします。Webテストの受験を頂かないと応募完了となりませんので、ご注意ください。

サマーインターン実施期間
2027-06中旬～2027-08上旬の8週間予定

場所
シティグループ 東京オフィス

応募方法
こちらのページのApplyボタンよりエントリーをお願いいたします。エントリー手続きの中で履歴書の添付が求められますので、必ずご提出ください。その際、厚生労働省が提示する履歴書フォーマット（ https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11654000/000769665.pdf ）を参考に、下記項目を必ず履歴書内に記入いただき、PDF形式でご提出をお願いいたします。

■重要注意事項
手書きの履歴書は受付出来かねますのでご留意ください。
以下の項目を必ず履歴書内に記載いただくようお願いいたします。
- 顔写真
- 氏名（漢字、フリガナ、アルファベット）※漢字名がない方は省略可
- 生年月日
- 大学・学位・卒業予定年月
- （大学院卒業の方は出身大学と卒業年月）
- 出身高校
- ゼミ、研究室
- 課外活動（クラブ・サークル・ボランティア）
- 英語レベル
- 日本語レベル
- 留学など（予定も含む）
- アルバイト、インターン
- その他特記されたい課外活動や成果
- 資格
- 志望理由

部門紹介
コーポレート・バンキング部門
コーポレート・バンキング部門は、シティならではの広範囲な商品とサービス、およびグローバルネットワークを駆使して、多国籍企業を中心とした法人のお客様のフィナンシャルパートナーとして、国内外での成長をサポートしています。シティは特にキャッシュ・マネジメント、カストディー・サービス、外国為替において、主要な市場調査で常にトップクラスにランクされており、また、日本のシンジケート・ローン市場においてもトップクラスのファイナンス・プロバイダーとして位置づけられています。そして、ストラクチャード・ファイナンス分野においては、1980年代中頃以降、長年に亘って画期的なソリューションを多数の法人のお客様に提供し、市場における先駆的なリーダーとして重要な役割を果たしてきました。
コーポレート・バンキングはリレーションシップ・マネジャー（RM）からなるお客様別の営業担当のラインと、コーポレート・ファイナンスの商品・サービスの開発と提供にあたる商品ラインにより組織されています。双方のラインが一体となって豊富なソリューションを提供するとともに、シティのグローバルなネットワークのもと連携することでお客様の国内外グループ会社等との総合的なお取引関係が可能な体制となっており、これがシティの比類ない強みとなっています。
Additional information about Citi Japan: https://www.citigroup.com/global/about-us/global-presence/ja-JP/japan

Corporate Banking 2027 Summer Internship Program

Recruitment Details
*Please ensure you read the "How to Apply" section carefully, as there are important notes regarding the entry sheet to be attached during the application.

Citigroup Japan is pleased to announce recruitment for its 2027 Summer Internship Program for Investment Banking division.

Recruiting Division
Corporate Banking

Eligibility
Applicants must meet one of the following criteria:
Applicants who are expected to graduate from a university or graduate school, either in Japan or overseas, by September 2028.

Application Deadline:
1st date: September 15
2nd date: October 15

※ Applicants will receive an invitation to complete a web-based assessment within approximately five business days after submitting their application.
Please note that your application will not be considered complete until you have completed the online assessment.

Summer Internship Period
Scheduled eight weeks between Mid-June 2027 and Early August 2027
Location
Citigroup Japan, Tokyo Office

Application Process
To apply, please click the "Apply" button on this page and submit your application online.
As part of the application process, candidates must upload a resume in PDF format.
When preparing your resume, please refer to the resume template provided by Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare:
https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11654000/000769665.pdf

■Important Notice
Handwritten resumes will not be accepted.
*Please ensure that your resume includes all of the following information:
- Photo / Headshot
- Full Name (Kanji, Furigana, Alphabet)  If you do not have a Kanji name, this section may be omitted.
- Date of Birth
- University, Degree, and Expected Graduation Month/Year
- (For graduate students, please also include your undergraduate university and graduation month/year)
- High School Attended
- Seminar/Laboratory
- Extracurricular Activities (Clubs/ Society/ Volunteer work)
- English Language Proficiency Level
- Japanese Language Proficiency Level
- Study Abroad Experience (including planned study abroad)
- Part-time Jobs, Internships
- Certificates
- Other notable extracurricular activities or achievements
- Reason for Application

About Corporate Banking
Citi’s Corporate Banking Division serves as a trusted financial partner to multinational corporations and other institutional clients, supporting their growth both in Japan and around the world through Citi’s broad range of products, services, and unparalleled global network.
Citi is consistently recognized as a market leader in key areas such as cash management, custody services, and foreign exchange, achieving top rankings in major industry surveys. In addition, Citi is recognized as one of the leading providers of financing solutions in Japan’s syndicated loan market. In the field of structured finance, Citi has played a pioneering role since the mid-1980s, delivering innovative and market-leading solutions to corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
The Corporate Banking Division is organized around two complementary functions: client coverage teams led by Relationship Managers (RMs), who maintain and develop client relationships, and product teams responsible for the development and delivery of corporate finance products and services. By working closely together and leveraging Citi’s extensive global network, these teams provide integrated financial solutions and seamless support to clients and their domestic and international subsidiaries. This collaborative, client-centric approach represents one of Citi’s unique competitive strengths.
Additional information about Citi Japan: https://www.citigroup.com/global/about-us/global-presence/ja-JP/japan

世界におけるシティ
シティは、国際取引を必要とするお客様のための卓越した金融パートナー、ウェルス・マネジメント分野のグローバルリーダーであり、米国市場で高く評価されているパーソナル・バンキング事業を展開している金融機関です。世界約180の国と地域において、個人、法人、政府機関などのお客様に、幅広い金融商品とサービスを提供しています。

日本におけるシティ
シティは、120年以上前に日本に参入し、以来、政府機関、金融機関、事業法人、機関投資家など、日本のお客様のあらゆるファイナンスのニーズにお応えしています。
その中心となるのは、コーポレート・バンキング（法人金融業務）、インベストメント・バンキング（投資銀行業務）、コマーシャル・バンキング（商業銀行業務）、マーケッツ（市場業務）、トレジャリー＆トレード・ソリューション（キャッシュ・マネジメントおよび貿易金融業務）、セキュリティーズ・サービス（証券サービス）です。コーポレート・バンキングとトレジャリー＆トレード・ソリューションは、外資系金融機関としては日本最大級の規模を誇ります。

シティのグローバル・ネットワークは、他に例を見ない広がりを誇り、革新的な商品とサービスと合わせて、シティならではの付加価値を提供し、お客様の成長を支援しています。

お客様との長年にわたるお付き合い
シティのお客様は、日本を代表する多国籍企業や金融機関から、機関投資家、政府機関、公的機関、さらに、日本に進出している多国籍企業や日本に投資しているグローバル機関投資家まで、多岐にわたります。お客様とのお付き合いは長いものでは60年を超え、日本企業の「海外でのメインバンク」という役割を担うなど、他の外資系金融機関とは一線を画す関係を築いています。

お客様のグローバルな活動を支えるネットワーク
シティは、真にグローバルな事業基盤を有する金融機関です。シティが事業を展開する国の数は、他の金融機関の追随を許しません。海外に進出する日本のお客様を現地でサポートするために設けられた「ジャパンデスク」は、現在11カ国にあり、進出先での事業展開、買収、投資などに関する支援を提供しています。シティの世界中を一つにつなぐ実績とノウハウは、国際的な視野を持って活躍する日本企業に、さらなる成功をもたらします。

沖縄でも20年以上業務を継続
1999年に那覇で業務を開始して以来、シティは沖縄で事業を展開しており、現在、オペレーションやテクノロジーなどの金融業務の一部を沖縄で行っています。現地での採用の強化などを通じて、今後も業容を拡充します。

jobs.description:

- Build and develop client relationships by tracking business development opportunities and contributing to the growth of Citi's Industrials franchise.

- Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution.

- A hybrid working model offering 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, supporting a healthy balance between collaboration and flexibility.

- Access to structured learning and professional development programs to help you continue growing as an advisor and leader.

- Exposure to a global network of clients, colleagues, and deals, providing broad experience and long-term career optionality.

- Competitive compensation and financial wellbeing benefits reflective of your contribution and seniority.

- Wellbeing support and programs designed to help you sustain high performance across all areas of your professional and personal life.

You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2026 - June 2027)

Who we think will be a great fit...
We are looking for motivated individuals, who are eager to grow their careers in Investment Banking. Successful candidates take pride in all aspects of their work and recognize that it is a reflection not just of the firm, but of themselves. Openness to diversity is something we highly value, and so should you.

We will also be looking for the following:
* Ability to win and sustain the loyalty of the most demanding institutional clients with confidence and good judgment
* Intellectual curiosity and proactive approach to searching for new and creative ideas to implement innovative investment banking strategies
* Enthusiasm for contributing to the Citi community, through teamwork, leadership, and mentoring
* Commitment to their own personal success and the success of the institution as a whole

Summer Interns are assigned to an industry or product coverage group, where you'll focus on financial analysis and business development.

Collecting & analyzing company information to assist in transactions, including conducting industry research, revising, and organizing financial data

If you are ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the board room, then Citi can help you get there! Citigroup Global Markets Inc. seeks an Investment Banking Sr Associate for its New York, NY location.

DUTIES: Prepare, analyze, and refine financial models, valuation analyses, research, and transaction materials to support client engagements, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to client delivery. Contribute subject-matter expertise through knowledge sharing and collaboration with team members on analytical approaches and best practices. Support business development and client relationship efforts by monitoring market activity, preparing thematic industry analyses, and contributing analytical insights for prospective opportunities; participate in client calls and discussions as a technical and analytical contributor. Develop client presentation materials, including pitchbooks, confidential information memoranda (CIMs), management presentations, and board and investor materials; contribute to the development of key messages and analytical positioning in collaboration with senior bankers. Execute M&A and capital-raising transactions by independently owning assigned analytical workstreams and coordinating directly with clients and external advisors, including legal, accounting, and financing counterparts, in support of transaction execution. Present analytical findings, transaction alternatives, and data-driven recommendations to senior bankers and clients through written materials and verbal discussions. Apply Citi’s internal risk management policies, committee processes, and product frameworks to support complex transaction approvals, acquisition financings, and strategic advisory engagements. A telecommuting/hybrid work schedule may be permitted within a commutable distance from the worksite in accordance with Citi policies and protocols.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field, and three (3) years of experience in the job offered or in a related financial occupation performing financial data analysis. Three (3) years of experience must include: Utilizing information in corporate financial statements and understanding the economic essence of important classes of complex business transactions; Analyzing companies’ accounting policies to determine impact of transactions on its primary financial statements; Evaluating operations, business plans, and financial and economic forecasts to produce strategic and financial analyses relating to the execution of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and the pro forma impact of the transaction; Performing complex financial modelling for valuation purposes, including building leverage buyout models, merger models, sum-of-the- parts models, discounted cash flow models, comparable company analysis, and precedent transaction analysis; Supporting execution of public mergers and acquisitions transactions by performing transaction analysis, conducting public company due diligence, and contributing to valuation analyses, process strategy materials, and shareholder communications; and Analyzing and interpreting financial statements and credit rating analysis based on public rating agency methodologies including S&P and Moody’s. 40 hrs./wk. jobs.description:
Citi is looking for an Investment Banking Senior Analyst to join its Banking, Capital Markets and Advisory team, playing a key role in advising clients on capital raising, mergers, acquisitions, and other strategic financial transactions. In this position, you will work alongside senior banking professionals, contributing directly to live deals and client mandates that shape business outcomes at a global scale. This is an opportunity to build deep expertise in investment banking while making a tangible impact for clients across complex, high-profile transactions.

Responsibilities
- Advise clients on capital markets transactions, mergers, acquisitions, and other strategic financial mandates as part of a senior-led deal team.
- Develop and maintain complex financial models to support valuations across a range of transaction types and industries.
- Prepare investment recommendations, valuation analyses, and statistical exhibits for client pitches and active deals.
- Organize and analyze sophisticated financial data to inform client proposals and strategic planning materials.
- Conduct in-depth economic and financial research to underpin transaction strategy and client advice.
- Evaluate company financial performance against industry benchmarks and broader market trends to generate actionable insights.
- Collaborate with senior Banking, Capital Markets and Advisory professionals across client transactions, contributing as a core member of the deal team.

Required Qualifications & Skills
- Two to five years of experience in investment banking, capital markets, or a related financial advisory discipline.
- FINRA Series 79 and Series 63 licenses, or ability to obtain them.
- Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, in a client-facing context.
- Proven capability to perform effectively under pressure in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in finance, economics, or a related field.

What We Offer

At Citi, you will work within one of the world's leading investment banking franchises, gaining direct exposure to complex, high-impact transactions alongside experienced professionals. We offer a performance-driven environment that supports your growth, rewards your contribution, and gives you the tools to build a long-term career in investment banking.
- Hybrid working model offering 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, supporting professional effectiveness and work-life balance.
- Access to structured learning and development programs designed to accelerate career progression in investment banking and capital markets.
- Exposure to a global network of senior banking professionals and cross-functional deal teams across products and geographies.
- Competitive compensation and financial wellbeing benefits reflective of your experience and contribution.
- Wellbeing support and resources to help you sustain high performance over the long term.
- A collaborative team environment where your analytical contributions directly influence client outcomes and transaction success.

Apply today to bring your investment banking expertise to a global team where your work shapes real outcomes for clients across markets.

Investment Banking - 投資銀行部門
投資銀行部門は、法人顧客の皆様に信頼されるファイナンシャル・パートナーとして、多岐にわたる金融商品とサービスを提供しています。比類なき規模を誇るグローバル・ネットワークを活用し、お客様の資金調達のあらゆるニーズにお応えするとともに、M&Aや株式発行関連の戦略的金融ソリューションも提供しています。新規発行、クロスボーダー取引、画期的なストラクチャリングなど、あらゆる案件をいかに困難な市場環境においても成功に導いてきた豊富な実績を有しています。その実績は、お客様に常に最高のサービスをお届けする、シティのコミットメントの証です。お客様の成長をお手伝いすることを通じて、日本および世界中で雇用を創出し、経済的な価値を高めることに寄与しています。

Additional Job Description
https://www.citigroup.com/global/about-us/global-presence/ja-JP/japan

世界におけるシティ
シティは、国際取引を必要とするお客様のための卓越した金融パートナー、ウェルス・マネジメント分野のグローバルリーダーであり、米国市場で高く評価されているパーソナル・バンキング事業を展開している金融機関です。世界約180の国と地域において、個人、法人、政府機関などのお客様に、幅広い金融商品とサービスを提供しています。

日本におけるシティ
シティは、120年以上前に日本に参入し、以来、政府機関、金融機関、事業法人、機関投資家など、日本のお客様のあらゆるファイナンスのニーズにお応えしています。
その中心となるのは、コーポレート・バンキング（法人金融業務）、インベストメント・バンキング（投資銀行業務）、コマーシャル・バンキング（商業銀行業務）、マーケッツ（市場業務）、トレジャリー＆トレード・ソリューション（キャッシュ・マネジメントおよび貿易金融業務）、セキュリティーズ・サービス（証券サービス）です。コーポレート・バンキングとトレジャリー＆トレード・ソリューションは、外資系金融機関としては日本最大級の規模を誇ります。

シティのグローバル・ネットワークは、他に例を見ない広がりを誇り、革新的な商品とサービスと合わせて、シティならではの付加価値を提供し、お客様の成長を支援しています。

お客様との長年にわたるお付き合い
シティのお客様は、日本を代表する多国籍企業や金融機関から、機関投資家、政府機関、公的機関、さらに、日本に進出している多国籍企業や日本に投資しているグローバル機関投資家まで、多岐にわたります。お客様とのお付き合いは長いものでは60年を超え、日本企業の「海外でのメインバンク」という役割を担うなど、他の外資系金融機関とは一線を画す関係を築いています。

お客様のグローバルな活動を支えるネットワーク
シティは、真にグローバルな事業基盤を有する金融機関です。シティが事業を展開する国の数は、他の金融機関の追随を許しません。海外に進出する日本のお客様を現地でサポートするために設けられた「ジャパンデスク」は、現在11カ国にあり、進出先での事業展開、買収、投資などに関する支援を提供しています。シティの世界中を一つにつなぐ実績とノウハウは、国際的な視野を持って活躍する日本企業に、さらなる成功をもたらします。

沖縄でも 20 年以上業務を継続
1999年に那覇で業務を開始して以来、シティは沖縄で事業を展開しており、現在、オペレーションやテクノロジーなどの金融業務の一部を沖縄で行っています。現地での採用の強化などを通じて、今後も業容を拡充します。

皆様のエントリーをお待ちしております！

jobs.title: Investment Banking Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
The Investment Banking Senior Analyst is responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing corporate finance and strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions.

In this role, you’re expected to:
- Work with senior Investment Banking officers and professionals and participate in client transactions projects or assignments as the junior member of the Investment Banking team
- Understands accounting concepts, reviews and extracts information from financial statements/filings, and incorporates it into financial analysis
- Prepare marketing materials, valuation and statistical exhibits etc. for pitches and live deals
- Build efficient and accurate financial models/analyses
- Source market/industry/product information to conduct research independently
- Reviews and delivers work in a timely manner
- Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally
- Manages across multiple projects, assignments and teams concurrently
- Works with team to adhere to and track internal processes while building an understanding of internal policies and procedures
- Demonstrates ability to understand relevant legal documents
- Demonstrates interest in understanding and applying market/industry/product trends and knowledge to clients and projects
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure: ​
- 2-5 years of relevant experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
- Experience in evaluating corporate transactions and structures
- Experience creating financial analyses
- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work under pressure in a rapidly changing environment in order to meet deadlines

Education:
- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

Shape your Career with Citi

- Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.
- Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.
- We have a variety of programs that help employees balance their work and life, including generous paid time off packages.

- Help support the senior members of the investment team in their delivery of investment solutions to clients.

- Recommend changes to the investors’ holdings after evaluating the economic, financial and market factors and the potential impact on the investors’ portfolios.

- Adhere to a specific prospecting code of conduct, which (1) permits acquiring new private client accounts only by referral or personal contact with an individual seeking to do business and (2) prohibits seminars, mail campaigns, cold calling and any other methods of solicitation.

- At least 5-8 years of experience
- Bachelor's degree with concentration of economics, finance or business administration; Professional experience or related occupation.
- Hold CACS Papers 1 & 2
- Ability to communicate with co-workers and clients; excellent written and communication skills, able to work without direction, self-motivated
- As this role will cover clients from North Asia, knowledge of Mandarin will be advantageous
